Never require all other products for this slice.

Validate required roles/receipts/tools for the selected gate first; null/absent nonrequired roles, candidate data, .NET or graphics-context inputs do not block headless G1.
Unknown conditional decisions block only affected cases/acceptance. Record partial-case results without passing the whole gate.
An explicitly selected subset of cases yields a partial receipt. It cannot satisfy a required full-gate receipt.

An execution recipe states any additional context/runtime closure used by startup/product probes before it runs. Unknown recipe inputs block that case only; static inventory-only evidence cannot be promoted to a runtime exclusion pass.

acceptedDecisionEvidence.note: Authoritative accepted outcomes are in TASKLIST; actual per-execution receipts bind selected artifacts. This map is an infrastructure contract, not product acceptance.

technicalContract.selection: resolve common plus selected gate/cases/variants only; no implicit full-matrix expansion. A role can be a hashed member/subtree rather than a separate archive. Null unrelated roles do not block ready cases.
technicalContract.inputValidation: draft=true is never runnable; unresolved selected required hashes, identities, artifacts, tools or receipts yield precise blocked/invalid input. Unknown decisions block only dependent cases/acceptance. Never substitute producer HEAD or filenames for artifact byte identity.
technicalContract.identity: archive SHA256 and separately hashed normalized relative path/size/SHA256 inventories; exact source/dirty/tuple provenance. Rehash actual inputs around checks; no self-trusted embedded checksum replaces independent handoff identity.
technicalContract.pathPolicy: reject absolute/traversal/drive/UNC entries, case-colliding paths, undeclared payload, symlink/reparse/hardlink escapes; source/output roots and extraction destinations are explicit and bounded. Never rename/delete live producer paths or write shared caches.
technicalContract.receipts: separate input producer/contract receipts from generated preflight/case/acceptance outputs. Bind results to actual artifact/case/gate/tuple and hashes. Case outcomes pass/fail/blocked/unsupported; an executed subset is partial and never closes a full gate.
technicalContract.runtimeAndIndependence: structural inventory success is not compile/run/graphics/independence evidence. Source-unavailable/environment/context results are generated and must actually qualify before the corresponding gate can pass; readable-source runs remain focused-only.
technicalContract.fixtureScope: synthetic temporary fixtures test validator sensitivity and receipt logic only. This slice creates no SDK/native/editor fixture, runs no product matrix and claims no product-gate pass. Product cases without actual implementation/artifacts stay blocked.
technicalContract.driver: python tests/separation/qualify.py --inputs <absolute-inputs.json> --gate <G> --out <owned-root>; permit --case/--variant for explicit partial selection. Reject or block the sealed example because draft/null inputs remain unresolved.
technicalContract.tests: focused standard-library Python validation tests cover healthy inventory plus bad hash/tree/path/case collision/link/receipt and gate-scope negatives. No external dependency or new workplace framework is required.
technicalContract.publicPrivate: separate private automation distribution and evidence from public SDK/Editor/runtime candidate members. G6 resolves exact candidate dependencies plus its own policy/docs/move requirements; it does not make early G1 wait for them.
